name: Doll Recollect
source: A young girl named Barako ends up trapped in a mansion with eleven magic dolls, with a size and anatomy different to humans in order to play a death game where each murder will put the life of one of Barako's three friends on the line.
translation: 名叫Barako的少女，被困在一座宅邸里，与十一具体型、身体构造都不同于人类的魔法人偶，展开死亡游戏。每发生一次谋杀，Barako三位朋友中的一人，便会性命堪忧。
